[USER] Asks for the ideal number of hashtags to use in a post.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instagram allows for up to 30 hashtags per post, but studies show that using 11 or fewer hashtags could have the greatest impact on engagement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Expert recommendations suggest using around 5-10 relevant hashtags per post on Twitter and LinkedIn, and 2-3 hashtags on Facebook.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is essential to use hashtags thoughtfully and strategically, focusing on relevance and quality over quantity.
